description.value: McBike and Sport is a community-oriented multi-sport shop in Smithers, BC, run by enthusiast owner-operators who only sell products in sports they actively participate in — cycling, fishing, running, and cross-country skiing. The shop provides a full range of bicycle repairs from flat tires to frame straightening and custom wheel building, positioning it as a capable mechanical resource for touring cyclists in northern BC. Smithers sits at the gateway to extensive trail networks and wilderness in the Bulkley Valley, and McBike serves as the local outdoor recreation hub.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from mcbike.ca. The repair services subpage explicitly states 'At McBike we do any repairs from flat tires to frame straightening' with experienced technicians who also ride, confirming mechanical support capability for touring cyclists. The mountain bike rentals page confirms a rental fleet including e-bikes and fat bikes; the website footer confirms the address and provides a phone number not present in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'McBike & Sport' but website consistently uses 'McBike and Sport' (ampersand vs. spelled-out 'and').
OSM record contains no phone number; (250) 847-5009 sourced from website footer only, so phone contact_confirmed is null.

COVID-era safety messaging (mask requirements, appointment-only repairs) is still present on the homepage, suggesting the site may not be actively maintained; current walk-in repair policy is therefore unclear.
OSM tag is shop=sports rather than shop=bicycle, which may cause under-indexing in bike-specific searches.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: McBike and Sport is an active full-service bike shop and rental operation in Smithers — a clear WWC fit and a valuable resource for touring cyclists navigating northern BC.

Bike rentals.detail: Fleet of Norco, Kona, and Giant mountain bikes for around-town and XC trail riding; also e-bikes and fat bikes available. Rental includes a lock and helmet
